title: A Massive Molecular Torus inside a Gas-poor Circumnuclear Disk in the Radio Galaxy NGC 1052 Discovered with ALMA
question: How does mass accretion work in the gas-poor radio galaxy NGC 1052: what are the gas content and kinematics of the circumnuclear disk and of a molecular torus seen in absorption?

data.bands: Bands 6 and 7 (CO J=2-1 at 230 GHz; CO J=3-2 and HCN J=4-3 near 345-355 GHz); three frequency setups
data.sensitivity: continuum rms 11.8-21.3 uJy/beam; per-channel rms 273.9-327.7 uJy/beam

what.value: Black-hole mass 1.5e8 Msun from stellar velocity dispersion

evidence.quote: black-hole mass of $1.5 \times 10^8$ M$_{\odot}$ derived with stellar velocity dispersion

evidence.loc: 4.5.3 Molecular gas mass of the torus
evidence.quote: Applying abundance ratios of $(0.2-4.1) \times 10^{-9}$ in HCN-to-H$_2$

evidence.quote: using the conversion formula described by (cite: 2005ARA&A..43..677S)

recipe.method: CASA standard calibration with phase self-calibration on the target, natural-weight imaging, visibility-domain continuum subtraction

recipe.goal: Identify CO clouds and CND, derive luminosities and gas mass
recipe.method: Threshold detection in CO 3-2 and 2-1 channel maps; L'CO from Solomon & Vanden Bout formula; mass via L'CO(3-2) with alpha_CO
key_parameters: alpha_CO(1-0) = 0.8 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1, thermalized CO transitions
assumptions: alternative Cen A-like X_CO = 5e20 gives 4.8e6 Msun

recipe.goal: Measure CND kinematics and enclosed mass
recipe.method: Linear regression on P-V diagram, terminal velocity, M_enc = R V^2 / G; Gaussian decomposition of rotation-subtracted profile
assumptions: CND rotationally supported ring seen edge-on

recipe.method: Single (or multi) Gaussian fits in optical depth to the core spectrum
LTE column density formula with equivalent width

recipe.goal: Solve covering factor and optical depth with clumpy torus
recipe.method: Radiative transfer constraint on H12CN and H13CN line-bottom flux with tau ratio 50, over a grid of Theta (0.4-1.0) and T_ex (50-500 K)
assumptions: 12C/13C ~ 50; torus larger than plasma torus (R >= 1 pc)

recipe.method: N_H2 from HCO+ with abundance ratio; M_torus = 2 pi Theta R^2 N_H2 mu; clump density via f_cov^{3/2}

recipe.goal: Specific angular momentum and sphere of influence
recipe.method: SAM = V_R R for torus, CND and clouds; Keplerian extrapolation crosses flat rotation at 14.4 pc
